fusions.name: Dusk Feeder
fusions.desc: Sends a darting bolt that deals 4 dark damage to the first enemy it meets, with a 35% chance to leave it with [Thief of Spirit] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Dissonant Shriek
fusions.desc: Shrieks, dealing 28 resonating damage to every enemy within 4 tiles and leaving them [Muddled] for 6 seconds. It ignores resistances.

fusions.name: Roost in Shadow
fusions.desc: Veils you for 6 seconds: enemies notice you 60% later, and the veil breaks the moment you attack. Your movement speed rises 20% for 4 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Lingering Echo
fusions.desc: Each time you spend mana, a bolt strikes the nearest enemy within 6 tiles, dealing 5 lightning damage. Once every 3 seconds.
